title: ervum pisiforme
intro: Ervum pisiforme, commonly known as Indian buttercup or pea-shape bean, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, which may contribute to the prevention of cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Ervum pisiforme include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic properties, which can help to protect the heart and prevent the formation of blood clots. The bioactive constituents of Ervum pisiforme include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
